prospective_history_rotation.rule: tuple chosen by seed mod 4 before outcomes

operator: 32x32 central-finite-difference Jacobian of the fully isolated 24-step x->m + 24-step m->x causal loop

primary_hypotheses.H1_G0_max_gain_contracts: mean sigma_max(G0) <0.15; >90% seeds <0.20; bootstrap 95% upper bound <0.20
primary_hypotheses.H2_G1_max_gain_contracts: mean sigma_max(G1) <0.15; >90% seeds <0.20; bootstrap 95% upper bound <0.20
primary_hypotheses.H3_finite_amplitude_top_mode_contracts: mean finite top-mode gain <0.15 at both G0 and G1; >90% seeds <0.20 at both stages
primary_hypotheses.H4_optimal_mode_exceeds_native_history: mean [sigma_max - historical norm gain] >0.04 at both G0 and G1; >80% seeds positive at both stages; bootstrap lower bounds >0

interpretation_rule.all_pass: the isolated loop is locally and finite-amplitude contractive even along its optimal direction; native history is additionally suboptimal, but alignment alone cannot make the loop regenerative
interpretation_rule.H1_H2_pass_H3_fail: linearized loop is contractive but finite-amplitude nonlinear regeneration remains possible
interpretation_rule.fail_H1_or_H2: a latent local regenerative mode exists in at least one stage/context

scope_warning: local causal loop gain in this reactor; not a statement about biological memory, phenomenology, or consciousness
